_comment: RECORDED MODEL DIGESTS of this repository's own Milan models, keyed by
refuses a recorded id whose model digest moved (L9 model-digest): a
structural change that kept its entity_model_id. It also refuses an id
with no record (L9 model-id-recorded). The digest is printed in the
layout report. Change a model and its id together, then record the new
pair here in the same commit.
